quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on Russell Westbrook's retirement and legacy
quotes.excerpt: Russell Westbrook announced after 18 years that he's hanging them up. I know we all have thoughts.
quotes.quote: Russell Westbrook announced after 18 years that he's hanging them up. I know we all have thoughts and opinions. He probably had something to do with you wearing zero. I know you as 22. I was introduced to you as 22, so I don't know where the zero came from. I'll let you tell that story, but I would guess Russ had some implications to everybody who wears zero. Thoughts on Russell Westbrook retiring, brother?

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on his respect for Russell Westbrook's physicality
quotes.excerpt: Whatever you guys see on TV and whatever you think, it's that. But imagine that physicality is hitting you.
quotes.quote: Whatever you guys see on TV and whatever you think, it's that. But imagine that physicality is hitting you. He's unbelievable, such a good dude. All conversations we've ever had have been awesome, so salute to him. That's unbelievable.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on Russell Westbrook's impact on his generation
quotes.excerpt: Russell Westbrook is such a polarizing player, but he's also a piece of this generation that we grew up on.
quotes.quote: It's sad because Russell Westbrook is such a polarizing player, but he's also a piece of this generation that we grew up on and we hold so close. And I think it opens up the reality that, though the NBA is in good hands, we got Tyrese Haliburton, Cooper Flagg, Victor Wembanyama, AJ Dybantsa just coming in the league, we got Anthony Edwards, we got we are in really good hands. But man, we love us some stuff. KD, Bron, Russ, Harden, your boy CP3. It was kind of crazy that he's not a part of the league. So it's just like, damn, we're getting that much. And I know we know we're close, but the reality hits hard when a Russell Westbrook is like, I'm gone. And we know he still got at least three strong years of playing.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on the NBA's future and the next generation
quotes.excerpt: We are so smart as basketball fans in 2026 that we've seen the signs and we just chose to ignore.
quotes.quote: We are so smart as basketball fans in 2026 that we've seen the signs and we just chose to ignore them. No disrespect, because I know you played for them, but if the Kings are the only team that want you at 30, Russ want more. He want to play for like a Nuggets like he was, can play in the playoffs. It's just tough if the Wizards and the Kings are teams that want him to come back, but then Russ decided to essentially retire. I'm happy for him. Me too. And that's what I said in the video I made today, where it's like we are so smart as basketball fans in 2026 that we've seen the signs and we just chose to ignore them.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on the difficulty of finding players with Westbrook's intensity
quotes.excerpt: I just don't know how we're going to find another player that plays as hard as him and at that level.
quotes.quote: I just don't know how we're going to find another player that plays as hard as him and at that level. I became a fan in that moment because you have to go through every year of their career, all the footage, all the interviews, all the articles. Like, shit, I just don't know how we're going to find another player that plays as hard as him and at that level.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on the pre-draft interview process with the Sacramento Kings
quotes.excerpt: they love you, they might trade up to get you.
quotes.quote: I interviewed with every other team. I interviewed with New York, I interviewed with Charlotte. And then the night before the draft, my agent goes, interview with Sacramento. I'm like, why am I interviewing with Sacramento? They're the 12th pick. He's like, they love you, they might trade up to get you. I'm like, whatever, dog. So I get on this call, and it wasn't even professional. Most of the calls are so professional. It was like a call with the homies. They were like, oh, we love you. You're not going to be available at our pick, but we just wanted to talk to you.

quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on the Chicago Bulls' draft selection process
quotes.excerpt: they're picking Patrick Williams.
quotes.quote: I'm asking my agent, what's up with the Bulls? We interviewed with them, and I'm like, what we hearing? And they're picking Patrick Williams. I'm like, okay, cool. Patrick's my dog, too. So I'm like, oh, dope, good for him.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on avoiding the Cleveland Cavaliers in the draft
quotes.excerpt: I told Atlanta absolutely do not draft me.
quotes.quote: Fifth pick was Cleveland. I did not interview with them because they had Darius Garland already. I was like, dude, not draft me. I told Atlanta absolutely do not draft me. So those are the two teams I told no. Now we get to Detroit. I'm like, oh, they need a point guard. Me. I know it's me. I look at my agent over there, and he like, I'm like, get the fuck. How? How? So then I saw Killian Hayes pop up.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on the Washington Wizards' draft selection process
quotes.excerpt: I'm avoiding all these point guards. I'm going to go back up John Wall?
quotes.quote: We get a call from DC. We drafting Tyrese at nine. I never interviewed with DC. And they had John Wall at the time. They had traded him for Russell Westbrook. I'm like, man, they got John Wall. I'm avoiding all these point guards. I'm going to go back up John Wall? What are you talking about? And I don't remember what happened. I think maybe they didn't think Killian, I think there was a talk that the Pistons were thinking about taking Deni Avdija. So then it went Obi Toppin and then me nine. That's what I think was going to happen.

They were like, look, we're drafting a power forward. And I was like, I didn't know who they were talking about. And I was like, okay, so they're not drafting me.

quotes.quote: I was at breakfast, I was eating breakfast, and my agent called me like, hey, the GM's being weird, I think you might be getting traded. I'm like, what? I'm like thinking he's playing. quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on the NBA's trade culture
quotes.excerpt: you're so used to like high school, college, it's like 1-2-3 family.
quotes.quote: You're so used to like high school, college, it's like 1-2-3 family. You know what I mean? Like everybody like, there's no like, if you transfer, you got to sit a year in college. Like everybody going to stay. We all go to school together. We're all like, those are your brothers, whatever. And like, that was like the first reality of like, wow, this is, this is what the NBA really, really looks like, you know what I'm saying?
